visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with styled black hair, wearing a white T-shirt, stands in a brightly lit indoor space with white walls and books on a shelf in the background. He holds a makeup brush and a palette, speaking directly to the camera with an expressive face and animated hand gestures. (2) He holds up a black zippered makeup pouch, showing it to the lens, then reaches inside to pull out a compact rectangular makeup palette. He brings the palette close to the camera, revealing its translucent lid and the brand name. (3) The man opens the palette to display two shades: a light cream and a cool-toned brown. He points to the pans, showing noticeable wear and 'hit pan' marks on the product, emphasizing its frequent use. (4) He demonstrates the product by swatching both shades on the inside of his wrist and then using a brush to apply the contour shade along his jawline, forehead, and nose, making exaggerated faces to show the effect. (5) A split-screen montage appears with nine identical frames of him smiling and holding the palette. The video ends with him speaking enthusiastically and gesturing toward the camera to share the content.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic 'Hello' as a bright, synth-heavy electronic track starts. A quick 'whoosh' sound marks the visual transition. The speech is rapid and energetic. (2) A subtle 'click' and 'rustle' can be heard as he interacts with objects. The background music maintains a steady 4/4 beat. A 'ding' sound effect highlights a price point appearing. (3) As he displays the makeup palette, his voice shifts to a more intimate, conversational tone. A 'pop' sound effect occurs when he opens the compact. (4) During the application demonstration, his vocal arousal increases, and he uses more dramatic inflections. A stylized 'shing' sound effect accompanies a visual swatch on his skin. (5) The speaker concludes with a fast-paced call to action, accompanied by a final comedic 'cartoon' spring sound effect and a rhythmic synth swell that peaks before ending cleanly.
